description: Golden fixtures for modifier stacking rules (PF2e Remaster). Same type = take highest; different types = sum.

stackingRules.bonuses: Same type: highest wins (no stacking). Different types: all sum.
stackingRules.penalties: Same type: most negative wins (no stacking). Different types: all sum.
stackingRules.untyped: Untyped bonuses do NOT stack with each other (highest wins). Untyped penalties DO stack (all sum).
stackingRules.source: §3.2 and specs/17 ModifierType definition; untyped penalty stacking per PF2e RAW (Archives of Nethys)

cases.description: Two circumstance bonuses: only highest applies
cases.rule: §3.2: bônus do mesmo tipo não se acumulam — usa-se o maior

cases.description: Two item bonuses: only highest applies
cases.rule: §3.2: bônus do mesmo tipo não se acumulam — usa-se o maior (item bônus)

cases.description: Two status bonuses: only highest applies
cases.rule: §3.2: bônus de status não se acumulam — usa-se o maior

cases.description: Circumstance + item bonuses: different types, they stack
cases.rule: §3.2: apenas bônus de tipos diferentes se somam (circumstance + item = 2 + 1 = 3)

cases.description: Circumstance + item + status bonuses: all different types, all stack
Two circumstance penalties: only most negative applies (highest magnitude wins)
cases.rule: §3.2: penalidades do mesmo tipo não se acumulam — usa-se a mais negativa

cases.description: Two status penalties: only most negative applies
cases.rule: §3.2: penalidades de status não se acumulam — usa-se a mais negativa

cases.description: Circumstance penalty + item penalty: different types, they stack
Untyped bonuses do NOT stack: highest wins
cases.rule: §3.2 + PF2e RAW: untyped bonuses do not stack with other untyped bonuses — highest wins

cases.description: Untyped penalties DO stack (unlike untyped bonuses)
cases.rule: PF2e RAW: untyped penalties (like MAP and range) stack with each other
cases.verifyNote: The research (§3.2) states untyped bonuses use highest; the spec lists MAP as untyped penalty that stacks. Confirm untyped-penalty stacking is intended for engine-2e MVP.

cases.description: Bonus and penalty of same type: they DO interact (net result)
cases.rule: §3.2: status bonus +1 e status penalty -2; per PF2e RAW, bonuses and penalties of the same type are treated separately. Net: best bonus (+1) + worst penalty (-2) = -1
cases.verifyNote: PF2e RAW applies same-type bonuses (take highest) and same-type penalties (take most negative) independently, then sums the two. Confirm this is the intended behavior in engine-2e.

cases.description: Proficiency modifier (typed 'proficiency'): treated as own type
cases.rule: specs/17 §Conceitos: proficiency is a typed modifier; same-type rule applies — only highest proficiency bonus counts

cases.description: Mixed: item bonus + status penalty + proficiency
cases.rule: §3.2: item (+2) + proficiency (+6) + status penalty (-1) = 7 (all different types, all apply)

cases.description: Three bonuses all different types: all stack
cases.rule: §3.2: item(1) + status(1) + circumstance(2) = 4; todos tipos distintos somam

cases.description: Two identical bonuses same type same source: only one counts (no double-dipping)
cases.rule: §3.2: mesmo tipo, mesmo valor — apenas um entra; sem empilhamento de bônus do mesmo tipo
